risk_note: F1-08dc (orchestrator D10-1402; contract CT-24zzj). The admin monthly settlement bill list gets a 只看待确认 checkbox: when applied the list request carries awaiting_confirm=true (with the month and status filters, kept on paging, removed on reset); unchecked sends no awaiting_confirm (never false). Opening /settle-bills?awaiting_confirm=true (the workbench card settle_bill_pending) starts with the box checked and the first list read carrying it; query / reset replace the address so it matches the form. Which bills are awaiting confirmation is decided by the server only; the page does not judge batches. Backend B2-09zm is not merged; rule tests use a contract-shaped fake server. Three files under apps/admin/src/pages/settle-bills and texts/settle-bills.ts; App.tsx untouched. Rule tests by an independent Claude in two rounds (r2 only renamed a .todo member access flagged by the no-restricted-syntax rule); tsc -b test 0 errors before commit; Codex spec-test r1 pass; red on couli-ci (7 tests, right reason). Implementation by Opus 5.5: couli-ci fast run 2 green, run.ts static 10/10. The review tool classifies the task as RV2: Codex money r1 fail with one S1 on test/replay/qa-03c/clawback-payout.int.test.ts, a file this task does not touch (the branch was based before QA-03cz #7 merged, so the review saw main's tightening as reverted); after rebasing on the current main, Codex money r2 pass. Written by hand.
